data.name: Watchdog.Health.directory.computersNotRedirected.Remedy
data.value: Consider redircmp so that new computers land in a managed OU.

data.name: Watchdog.Health.directory.connection.Remedy
data.value: Check that the DC is reachable (LDAP 389, Kerberos) and that the service account is enabled.

data.name: Watchdog.Health.directory.notSynchronized.Remedy
data.value: The DC reports isSynchronized = FALSE – check replication.

data.name: Watchdog.Health.eventlog.Remedy
data.value: Check the firewall (Remote Event Log Management) and membership in Event Log Readers.

data.name: Watchdog.Health.eventlog.foreignRecords
data.value: Foreign records in the log of {0}

data.name: Watchdog.Health.eventlog.foreignRecords.Remedy
data.value: The collector forwards events of computers that are not DCs of this domain – check the WEF subscription.

data.name: Watchdog.Health.permission.Remedy
data.value: Grant the service account read access (docs/WATCHDOG.md).

data.name: Watchdog.Health.permission.accountRestrictions.Remedy
data.value: Delegate read access to userAccountControl, pwdLastSet and accountExpires.

data.name: Watchdog.Health.permission.configurationPartition.Remedy
data.value: Grant read access to CN=Sites in the configuration partition (new DCs).

data.name: Watchdog.Health.permission.deletedObjects.Remedy
data.value: Deletions are found only by the nightly reconciliation – grant List Contents on CN=Deleted Objects (dsacls).

data.name: Watchdog.Health.permission.domainPolicy.Remedy
data.value: Grant read access to the domain head (lockoutDuration, maxPwdAge).

data.name: Watchdog.Health.permission.passwordSettings.Remedy
data.value: Grant read access to the Password Settings Container (effective lockout duration).

data.name: Watchdog.Health.permission.replicationMetadata.Remedy
data.value: Without replication metadata the originating DC and time are unknown – check the read permissions.

data.name: Watchdog.Health.permission.search.Remedy
data.value: The domain controller refused the change search – check that the service account is enabled and can read the domain (docs/WATCHDOG.md).

data.name: Watchdog.Health.permission.uSNChanged.Remedy
data.value: Some objects are invisible to change tracking – delegate GenericRead to the service account.

data.name: Watchdog.Health.rules.Remedy
data.value: Check the rule configuration on the Rules tab.

data.name: Watchdog.Health.rules.configuredDns
data.value: Configured DNs that no longer exist

data.name: Watchdog.Health.rules.configuredDns.Remedy
data.value: An OU or group named in the configuration was renamed, moved or deleted – rules, privileged groups and subtrees that use the old DN match nothing. Correct the distinguished names listed in the details.

data.name: Watchdog.Health.rules.planner.Remedy
data.value: The service is installed incompletely – events are recorded but no notifications are sent; reinstall the service.

data.name: Watchdog.Health.runtime.Remedy
data.value: Update the .NET runtime of the service host.

data.name: Watchdog.Health.secret.Remedy
data.value: Enter the affected passwords and secrets again.

data.name: Watchdog.Health.secret.unreadable.Remedy
data.value: The service account changed – enter the channel passwords and secrets again.

data.name: Watchdog.Health.smtp.Remedy
data.value: Check the SMTP settings with a test e-mail.

data.name: Watchdog.Health.storage.Remedy
data.value: Check the data folder of the service.

data.name: Watchdog.Health.storage.acl.Remedy
data.value: The data folder has a wider ACL than allowed – restore the protected ACL (docs/WATCHDOG.md).

data.name: Watchdog.Health.storage.free.Remedy
data.value: Free space on the data disk or lower the retention.

data.name: Watchdog.Health.storage.maintenance.Remedy
data.value: Retention or database maintenance failed – check the Application log on the service host.

data.name: Watchdog.Health.storage.size.Remedy
data.value: The database approaches Retention.MaxDatabaseMb – shorten the retention or raise the limit.

data.name: Watchdog.Hint.secret.rebindRequired
data.value: The destination changed – enter the password or secret again.

data.name: Watchdog.Hint.smtp.basicAuthDisabled
data.value: Basic SMTP AUTH is disabled for the tenant – use OAuth2 (Exchange Online) or a relay.

data.name: Watchdog.Hint.smtp.directSendRejected
data.value: Direct send was rejected (5.7.68) – use an authenticated connection or a connector.

data.name: Watchdog.Hint.smtp.smtpAuthDisabled
data.value: SMTP AUTH is disabled for the mailbox – run Set-CASMailbox -SmtpClientAuthenticationDisabled $false.

data.name: Watchdog.Hint.smtp.startTlsMissing
data.value: The server does not offer STARTTLS – credentials are never sent unencrypted.

data.name: Watchdog.Hint.teams.acceptedNotDelivered
data.value: Teams accepted the message (202); delivery to the channel is not confirmed – check the channel.

data.name: Watchdog.Hint.teams.authMismatch
data.value: The flow expects another authentication (SAS vs. OAuth) – check the trigger settings.

data.name: Watchdog.Hint.teams.retiredUrl
data.value: Office 365 connector URLs were retired – create a Power Automate Workflows trigger.

data.name: Watchdog.Hint.tls.certificateUntrusted
data.value: The server certificate is not trusted – install the CA certificate or pin the certificate.

data.name: Watchdog.Hint.tls.revocationUnavailable
data.value: Revocation could not be checked – allow access to the CRL/OCSP addresses.

data.name: Watchdog.Hint.webhook.gone
data.value: The receiver answered 410 Gone – the endpoint no longer exists.

data.name: Watchdog.Kind.HealthEventLogGap
data.value: Gap in a DC security log

data.name: Watchdog.Kind.ManagedPasswordReadersChanged
data.value: Readers of a managed password changed

data.name: Watchdog.Kind.PasswordMustChangeSet
data.value: User must change password at next logon

data.name: Watchdog.Kind.SecurityDescriptorChanged
data.value: Permissions of a critical object changed

data.name: Watchdog.Reason.AMBIGUOUS.Remedy
data.value: Several possible actors – see the evidence.

data.name: Watchdog.Reason.DC_UNREACHABLE.Remedy
data.value: Check the firewall (Remote Event Log Management) and the service account's membership in Event Log Readers.

data.name: Watchdog.Reason.LOG_OVERWRITTEN.Remedy
data.value: Increase the size of the Security log on the DCs (at least 1 GB).

data.name: Watchdog.Reason.NO_MATCH.Remedy
data.value: No matching event was found in the time window.

data.name: Watchdog.Reason.PENDING.Remedy
data.value: The actor is being determined from the DC security logs.

data.name: Watchdog.Reason.SACL_MISSING.Remedy
data.value: Add a SACL for directory service changes (docs/WATCHDOG.md, section 4.6).

data.name: Watchdog.Reason.SELF_CHANGE.Remedy
data.value: The computer changed its own object.

data.name: Watchdog.Reason.SOURCE_DISABLED.Remedy
data.value: Enable attribution in the configuration – the service must run on Windows.

data.name: Watchdog.Reason.SOURCE_LOGON_NOT_FOUND.Remedy
data.value: The logon session is older than the search window or the log was overwritten – increase the Security log.

data.name: Watchdog.Reason.SOURCE_NOT_COLLECTED.Remedy
data.value: Add 4624/4771/4776 to the WEF subscription (docs/WATCHDOG.md, section 4.4).

data.name: Watchdog.Reason.SYSTEM.Remedy
data.value: The change was made by the domain controller itself (e.g. SDProp).

data.name: Watchdog.Rollout.Banner
data.value: Rollout mode until {0}: immediate notifications only for critical events – adjust the rules and end rollout mode.

data.name: Watchdog.Rollout.EndConfirm
data.value: End rollout mode now? All rules will notify immediately according to their settings.

data.name: Watchdog.Rule.PreviewLimit
data.value: (scan limit reached – the numbers are incomplete)

data.name: Watchdog.Rules.DeleteConfirm
data.value: Delete the rule "{0}"? The change takes effect when the configuration is saved.

data.name: Watchdog.Rules.NoDefault
data.value: The service has no built-in rule with this id.

data.name: Watchdog.Rules.ResetConfirm
data.value: Replace the rule "{0}" with its shipped version? Its changes and exclusions are lost when the configuration is saved.

data.name: Watchdog.Status.Counts
data.value: Events: {0} · unacknowledged: {1} · high or critical unacknowledged: {2}

data.name: Watchdog.Test.RebindRequired
data.value: The destination changed – enter the password or secret again.

data.name: Watchdog.Ui.AddressHint
data.value: The watchdog is a separate service that records the changes in the domain around the clock. Enter the https:// address of the service – the tab connects with Kerberos as the signed-in user. Only the address is stored.

data.name: Watchdog.Ui.AllEnabledChannels
data.value: All enabled Teams and webhook channels

data.name: Watchdog.Ui.AllowedHosts
data.value: Allowed hosts (one per line; empty = any https host)

data.name: Watchdog.Ui.AnyTags
data.value: At least one of the tags

data.name: Watchdog.Ui.CheckRevocation
data.value: Check the revocation of the server certificate

data.name: Watchdog.Ui.CoverNonBusinessDays
data.value: After days off the digest covers the whole period since the previous one

data.name: Watchdog.Ui.DigestPreviewHint
data.value: Click "Preview" to see the digest as it would be sent now. The preview is not stored anywhere.

data.name: Watchdog.Ui.EmptyIsDefault
data.value: An empty field uses the service default.

data.name: Watchdog.Ui.EventNoLongerMatches
data.value: No longer matches the filter – leaves the list once it is deselected

data.name: Watchdog.Ui.ExcludeActors
data.value: Ignore changes made by (SIDs, one per line)

data.name: Watchdog.Ui.ExcludeSelfChanges
data.value: Ignore changes an object made to itself

data.name: Watchdog.Ui.FilterTextHint
data.value: Search: name, logon, actor, workstation, IP…

data.name: Watchdog.Ui.FilterUnresolvedHint
data.value: Only events whose actor could not be determined

data.name: Watchdog.Ui.GeneratedSecretHint
data.value: New signing secret – copy it into the webhook receiver now. It is not shown again once the configuration is saved.

data.name: Watchdog.Ui.GitHubSignature
data.value: Also send the X-Hub-Signature-256 header (GitHub compatible)

data.name: Watchdog.Ui.IncludeSubtrees
data.value: Only in locations (DNs, one per line; empty = whole domain)

data.name: Watchdog.Ui.NeedsAdSession
data.value: Picking from the directory needs a connection to the domain.

data.name: Watchdog.Ui.NoChannels
data.value: No Teams or webhook channels – notifications go by e-mail only.

data.name: Watchdog.Ui.NoEventSelected
data.value: Select an event to see what changed, who did it and from where.

data.name: Watchdog.Ui.NoRuleSelected
data.value: Select a rule to edit it.

data.name: Watchdog.Ui.OpenInAdMngHint
data.value: Opens the object at its current location (needs a connection to that domain); a deleted object opens the AD Recycle Bin.

data.name: Watchdog.Ui.PinnedSha256
data.value: SHA-256 of the server certificate (64 hex characters)

data.name: Watchdog.Ui.PresetHint
data.value: Only the filter is saved – never event data.

data.name: Watchdog.Ui.RedactedHint
data.value: Exclusions, recipient addresses and credentials are hidden – only their number is shown.

data.name: Watchdog.Ui.RuleAttributes
data.value: Only changes of attributes (LDAP names, comma separated)

data.name: Watchdog.Ui.RuleHasIssues
data.value: The service reported issues for this rule

data.name: Watchdog.Ui.RuleKindsHint
data.value: Nothing selected = every kind of event.

data.name: Watchdog.Ui.SendWhenEmpty
data.value: Send even when there were no events

data.name: Watchdog.Ui.SidOnlyHint
data.value: SIDs only (S-1-5-21-…) – account names are never stored.

data.name: Watchdog.Ui.TabBadge
data.value: Unacknowledged events with High or Critical severity

data.name: Watchdog.Ui.TestUsesUnsaved
data.value: The test uses the unsaved settings.

data.name: Watchdog.Ui.UrlIsSecret
data.value: The URL is a secret (it carries an access signature) – after saving only its beginning is shown.

data.name: Watchdog.Validation.acceptAnyNotAllowed
data.value: Accepting any certificate is allowed only in development.

data.name: Watchdog.Validation.duplicateId
data.value: The identifier is used more than once.

data.name: Watchdog.Validation.exchangeOnlineBasic
data.value: Basic SMTP AUTH of Exchange Online is disabled by default from end of December 2026 – use OAuth2.

data.name: Watchdog.Validation.exclusionReason
data.value: Every exclusion needs a reason (up to 500 characters) and its author.

data.name: Watchdog.Validation.hostNotAllowed
data.value: The host is not in the allowed hosts of the channel.

data.name: Watchdog.Validation.inactiveLow
data.value: Fewer than 45 days report many accounts as inactive (lastLogonTimestamp lag).

data.name: Watchdog.Validation.invalidAttribute
data.value: Not a valid attribute (no wildcards, secrets or noise attributes).

data.name: Watchdog.Validation.invalidId
data.value: Use lower-case letters, digits and hyphens ("email" is reserved).

data.name: Watchdog.Validation.invalidScope
data.value: Not a documented Power Automate scope of this cloud.

data.name: Watchdog.Validation.invalidSid
data.value: Not a valid SID (names are not accepted).

data.name: Watchdog.Validation.lockedRule
data.value: A locked rule cannot be disabled, deleted or narrowed.

data.name: Watchdog.Validation.noRecipients
data.value: The rule notifies immediately but has no recipients or channels.

data.name: Watchdog.Validation.noTls
data.value: Without enforced TLS the alerts can be read or altered on the way.

data.name: Watchdog.Validation.oauthHostNotAllowed
data.value: This host may not receive OAuth tokens (bootstrap setting OAuthSmtpHosts).

data.name: Watchdog.Validation.pinnedHash
data.value: Enter the SHA-256 as 64 hexadecimal characters.

data.name: Watchdog.Validation.pollFast
data.value: Polling more often than every 10 seconds loads the DC.

data.name: Watchdog.Validation.range
data.value: The value is out of the allowed range.

data.name: Watchdog.Validation.redactedConfig
data.value: A redacted (Viewer) configuration cannot be saved.

data.name: Watchdog.Validation.retiredTeamsUrl
data.value: Office 365 connector URLs were retired – use a Power Automate Workflows URL.

data.name: Watchdog.Validation.rolloutOff

data.name: Watchdog.Validation.schemaUnavailable
data.value: The schema could not be read – the attribute cannot be checked now.

data.name: Watchdog.Validation.secretRebindRequired
data.value: The destination changed – enter the password or secret again.

data.name: Watchdog.Validation.secretWithoutChannel

data.name: Watchdog.Validation.smtpDisabledButUsed
data.value: Recipient groups are used while e-mail is disabled.

data.name: Watchdog.Validation.teamsUrlFormat
data.value: Not a standard Power Automate Workflows URL.
